text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been running toward the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe up to this day. Judging by my 
ability and reputation... the headwinds 
are strong. That is precisely why I must 
carefully discern when to make my 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Nakayama Festa, the Keisei Hai was a 
testing ground for overseas racing. Today 
marked the first fork in the road of fate.
